require 'rubygems'
require 'json'
require 'socket'
require 'timeout'

gem 'io-stream', '= 0.11.1'
require 'io/stream'
spec = Gem.loaded_specs.fetch('io-stream')
raise 'io-stream loaded outside staged image' unless spec.full_gem_path.include?('/image/')
raise 'unexpected io-stream runtime dependency' unless spec.runtime_dependencies.empty?

Timeout.timeout(15) do
  left, right = Socket.pair(:UNIX, :STREAM, 0)
  stream = IO.Stream(left)
  right.write("staged read\n")
  raise 'read mismatch' unless stream.gets == "staged read\n"
  stream.write("staged write\n")
  stream.flush
  raise 'write mismatch' unless right.gets == "staged write\n"
  right.close_write
  raise 'EOF mismatch' unless stream.read.nil? || stream.finished?
  stream.close
  right.close
end
puts "PASS ruby#{RUBY_VERSION} io-stream=#{spec.version} staged activation + buffered read/write/flush/EOF; openssl=#{OpenSSL::VERSION}"

# Exercise the OpenSSL integration using the implementation's bundled gem,
# with no certificate files or external connections.
Timeout.timeout(15) do
  key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(2048)
  certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new
  certificate.version = 2
  certificate.serial = 1
  certificate.subject = certificate.issuer = OpenSSL::X509::Name.parse('/CN=staged-test')
  certificate.public_key = key.public_key
  certificate.not_before = Time.now - 1
  certificate.not_after = Time.now + 60
  certificate.sign(key, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new)
  context = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext.new
  context.cert = certificate
  context.key = key
  left, right = Socket.pair(:UNIX, :STREAM, 0)
  server = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLSocket.new(left, context)
  client = OpenSSL::SSL::SSLSocket.new(right)
  worker = Thread.new do
    server.accept
    stream = IO.Stream(server)
    raise 'TLS read mismatch' unless stream.gets == "TLS request\n"
    sleep(0.05) # Force the client through the nonblocking TLS wait path.
    stream.write("TLS response\n")
    stream.flush
    stream.close
  end
  client.connect
  stream = IO.Stream(client)
  stream.write("TLS request\n")
  stream.flush
  raise 'TLS response mismatch' unless stream.gets == "TLS response\n"
  worker.value
  stream.close
  left.close
  right.close
end
puts "PASS ruby#{RUBY_VERSION} io-stream TLS socket-pair read/write with bundled openssl=#{OpenSSL::VERSION}"

gem 'async-http', '= 0.91.0'
require 'async/http'
require 'async/http/client'
require 'async/http/endpoint'
http_spec = Gem.loaded_specs.fetch('async-http')
raise 'async-http loaded outside staged image' unless http_spec.full_gem_path.include?('/image/')
endpoint = Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse('http://localhost:12345')
raise 'endpoint mismatch' unless endpoint.port == 12345
Async { |task| task.sleep(0.001) }.wait
puts "PASS ruby#{RUBY_VERSION} async-http=#{http_spec.version} client/endpoint load + Async scheduler with staged dependency closure"
puts JSON.generate(Gem.loaded_specs.transform_values { |s| {version: s.version.to_s, path: s.full_gem_path} })
